messages:
Olivier (Hiring): Maya accepted our offer. Her spouse has an H-4 EAD and will arrive in US with family. Questions: can spouse be added to benefits immediately? Any docs we need?
Maya (Candidate): Hi all  yes spouse arrives with H-4 EAD cards in hand. Wed like to add them to medical + dental on day 1 if possible. Also have a toddler dependent. What proof do you need?
Lena (People Ops): Congrats! Short answer: dependents can be added to medical/dental but we need proof of relationship (marriage certificate, birth certificate) and proof of eligibility to work (EAD) for the spouse only if theyre also being paid. For benefits enrollment we need dependent docs within 30 days of hire for special enrollment.
Gus (Benefits): To enroll spouse/child at hire: 1) Completed benefits enrollment form online. 2) Marriage certificate (scanned). 3) Dependent birth certificate. 4) Copy of spouse's EAD card if spouse will be covered as employee or to confirm immigration status (not strictly required for dependent coverage but good to have). If docs missing, we can provisionally enroll and then validate within 30 days.
Owen (Payroll): Payroll notes: if spouse will be paid by Redwood (we don't typically) we need SSN or ITIN and I-9 for the spouse. For benefits pre-tax premium deductions, we need enrollment set up before first payroll cutoff. If docs arrive late, premiums may start on next cycle and we may have to do manual adjustments.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Immigration point: H-4 EAD validity must be current for spouse to be employed; coverage as a dependent is separate from work authorization. If the spouse arrived with an EAD application receipt (I-797C) but card not issued, we can still enroll them as dependent but not employ them. If EAD is pending, advise spouse not to start any US-paid work until card is issued.
Maya (Candidate): Spouse has the actual EAD card and SSN already from prior stay. Well upload copies. Any delay expected on benefits side?
Gus (Benefits): If we receive docs by end of day Weds, we can get enrollment effective first of next month. If hire date is mid-month, some plans allow prorated premiums and effective dates vary by carrier. I'll confirm carrier effective rules and post here.
Lena (People Ops): Action items: Maya upload marriage + birth cert + spouse EAD + spouse SSN (front page of card okay) to the secure portal. Gus will confirm effective date. Owen: check payroll cutoff for premium pre-tax deduction.
Owen (Payroll): Payroll cutoff for next run is Fri at 5pm PT. If benefits selected and docs in by cutoff, deduction starts on that run. Otherwise next run. Also confirm direct deposit and W-4 for Maya before cutoff for timely pay.
Maya (Candidate): Uploaded docs to secure link just now (marriage cert, child's birth cert, spouse EAD scan). Also filled benefits elections.
hr-bot: Reminder set: verify dependent docs within 30 days and clear enrollment. Tag: "dependent-enroll". :white_check_mark:
Gus (Benefits): Received. Carrier note: medical & dental will be effective on the 1st of next month after enrollment. If Mayas start date is within the same month, child will be covered from carrier effective date (not retro). I can request expedited effective date for qualifying life event but starting employment typically doesn't qualify for retro start. More details in DM.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): One more FYI: if spouse intends to work in US for another employer, they should carry EAD and SSN docs when starting. Also ensure I-9 completion within 3 business days for any US payroll start.
Maya (Candidate): Understood. Thanks. One more question: does adding spouse impact our premium cost / equity eligibility?
Gus (Benefits): Adding family increases premium via dependent tier  payroll will show new pre-tax deductions. Equity eligibility unaffected; time-in-service remains same. We'll calculate monthly premium delta and DM you an estimate.
Lena (People Ops): Also note 401k: spouse is not a beneficiary for contributions but can be a beneficiary for account. Open enrollment for other perks unaffected.
Owen (Payroll): If documents check passes, we will start premium deduction on next payroll per cutoff. If any backdating needed due to late docs, we can process a manual adjustment but prefer to avoid.
Maya (Candidate): Thanks team  appreciate the quick responses. Excited to join.
Olivier (Hiring): Thanks everyone. Welcome Maya!
hr-bot: Checklist updated: "dependent-docs-received" and schedule follow-up: 20 days.
